notes: kb/Work PB5195 landed. §1985:VI.6.7.3 SR1: 'Procedure-name-1 is the name of a paragraph that contains a single sentence consisting of a GO TO statement without the DEPENDING phrase.' BindAlter resolves procedure-name-1 and reports COBOL1757 when the resolution names a section (ResolvedProcedure.IsSection, the resolution's own answer; PcRange.IsParagraph, which a one-paragraph section met, is deleted), when the paragraph is empty, or unless AlterIsSoleGoToParagraph (one sentence, one statement, a GO TO whose GoToFormats.Of is not Depending). Witnesses: 1985-SR-VI_6_7_3-1 and pb5195-alter-one-paragraph-section-85 (ALTER S7, S7 a section whose one paragraph is a lone GO TO, refused at 85).

next.reason: 1985: "Procedure-name-1 is the name of a paragraph that contains a single sentence consisting of a GO TO statement without the DEPENDING phrase."; 2023: "No ALTER statement: no candidate covers it; the GO TO format (14.9.17.2) has only unconditional and DEPENDING forms, no ALTER target.". 2023 has no ALTER statement. No candidate comes from an ALTER clause, and none covers altering a paragraph that holds a single GO TO sentence, so the feature and its rule are gone.
